Tua hun lai-in Yeroboam’ tapa Abiyah a cina hi;

Yeroboam in a zi kiangah, “Ding inla, Yeroboam’ zi na hih lam amaute in hong theih loh nadingin na meel seelin Shiloh ah pai in. Man taktak hi, hih mite tungah kumpi ka hih ding lam hong gen kamsangpa Ahiyah tua lai-ah om hi.
Anlum sawm, moh pawlkhat leh khuaizu thawl khat keng inla, ama kiangah va pai in. Amah in naupang tungah bang piang ding hiam cih hong gen ding hi.
Yeroboam’ zi in ama cih bangin a hih hi. Tuanu tho-in Shiloh ah pai a, Ahiyah’ inn ah a tung hi. Tu-in Ahiyah a kum tamlua ta ahih manin a mit miala khua a mu thei nawn kei hi;

Ahih hangin Yahweh in Ahiyah kiangah, “En in, a tapa a cina ahih manin nang kiang panin a tapa thu hong dong dingin Yeroboam’ zi hong pai hi. Nangma in ama tungah tua bang tua bang danin na dawng ding a, ahih hangin amah hong tun ciangin, mi dang khatpeuh hong kineih ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ahiyah in tuanu kongkhak a tunna kheging a zak ciangin, amah in, “Hong tum in, Yeroboam’ zi aw. Bang hangin mi dang kineih na hi hiam? Nang tungah thusia kong puak ding hi.
Pai inla Yeroboam kiangah gen in: “Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘mipite lak panin nang kong laamto a, Ka mi Israyl-te tungah ukpa kong suaksakin,

David’ innkuan panin kumpigam balkhia-in nang tungah kong pia hi. Ahih hangin Ka mit ah a manin a gamtat nadingin Ka thupiaknate zui-in a lungsim khempeuh tawh kei hong zui Ka nasempa David na bang kei hi.

Nang ma-a mi khempeuh sangin a siazaw-in na gamta hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah pai-in, nong hehsak nadingin a kikham pasiante (elohim), a kisung milimte nang aa dingin bawlin, na nunglam ah Kei hong paai hi!

Hih thu hangin en in! Keimah in Yeroboam innkuan tungah siatna ka tungsak ding hi! Sila hitaleh sila lo hitaleh Israyl sunga Yeroboam’ gui pasal khempeuh ka satmai ding hi! Mi khat in nin a beisiang dong a paihsiang bangin Yeroboam innkuan a omlaisunte zong ka susia ding hi.
Khuapi sunga Yeroboam mi a sipa uite in ne ding hi. Gamlaka a sipa huihlaka sasial ne vasate in ne ding uh hi. Yahweh in genkhin hi!’ a ci hi.
Tu-in ding in. Na inn ah ciahkik in. Khuapi sungah a lut dingin na khe na sik ciangin na tapa si ding hi.

Israyl khempeuh in amah kahin vui ding uh hi; ahih hangin Yeroboam sung panin ama han sung ngiata kivui ding amah bek ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl’ Pa Yahweh lama a man khatpeuh Yeroboam innkuan sung panin ama sung bek ah kimu hi.
Yahweh in Yeroboam’ innkuan a satmai dingin Israyl tungah kumpi khat laamto tawm ding hi! Tua ni pen tuni hita hi! Kala! Tu mahmah nangawn ah hita!

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Israyl vat ding ahih manin tui sunga pumpeeng kiling bang ding hi. A pu a pate tungah a piak hih gam hoih panin Amah in Israyl-te zunglot ding a, Euphrates Gun gal ah a thehthang ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in sing tawh Asherah Khuampite bawlin Yahweh a hehsak uh hi!
Tua ciangin Yeroboam khialhna leh Israyl-te a khialhsakna ahi Yeroboam’ mawhnate hangin Amah in Israyl nusia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yeroboam’ zi paikhia-in Tirzah ah a pai hi. A inn sangkil a kan laitakin naupang a si hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in amah vui uh a, Ama nasempa kamsang Ahiyah tungtawna kigen Yahweh’ kammal bang linlianin Israyl khempeuh in amah a kah uh hi.
Tu-in Yeroboam uk hun sunga thupiang dangte, a gal kidonate leh a ukziate; en un, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Yeroboam in kum 22 sung ukin, tua khit ciangin a pate tawh a ihmu hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Nadab in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.

Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam in Yahdah gam sung a uk hi. Rehoboam kumpi a suahin a kum 41 hi a, Yahweh in a Min a phutkip nadingin Israyl minamte khempeuh lak panin a teelkhiat khuapi Yerusalem ah amah in kum 17 sung a uk hi. A nu’ min pen Naamah hi a, Ammon mi ahi hi.
Yahweh muhna ah Yahdah-te a sia gamta uh a, amaute in a pate uh hihsa sangin a lianzaw amau bawl a mawhnate uh tawh ama hazat dingin Yahweh a sinsosak uh hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in zong mual sang tung khempeuh leh singniim nuai khempeuh ah mun sangte, a siangtho khuampite; masseboth, leh a siangtho khuamte; asherim, lam tawm uh hi.
A gam sungah pasal kizuakte nangawn a om hi. Yahweh in Israyl mite mai pana a notkhiat minamte’ a kihhuai gamtatna khempeuh amaute gamta uh hi!
Tua ciangin Kumpi Rehoboam’ uk zawh a kum ngana kumin Egypt kumpi Shishak in Yerusalem a sim hi.
Amah in Yahweh’ Inn pan leh kumpi-inn panin van manphate a puakhia hi. Amah in na khempeuh a puakhia hi. Amah in Solomon’ bawlsa kham lumte khempeuh zong a puakhia hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Rehoboam in tuate tangin sumngo lumte bawla kumpi-inn lutna a cing inncing ukte’ khut sungah a koih hi.
Tua bangin Yahweh’ Inn sungah kumpipa a pai simin, a cingte in tuate pua-in, tua khit ciangin inncinna inndei sungah tuate a koihkik zel uh hi.
Tu-in Rehoboam’ uk sunga thupiang adangte leh a sepsa khempeuh Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Rehoboam leh Yeroboam a nuntak sung tawntungin amau tegel kikalah kidona om tawntung hi.
Tua ciangin Rehoboam a pate tawh ihmu-in David’ Khuapi sungah a pate tawh kivui khawm hi. A nu’ min Naamah hi a, Ammon mi ahi hi. Tua khit ciangin a tapa Abiyah in a kumpi’ za luah hi.
Nebat’ tapa kumpi Yeroboam’ ukna a kum sawm le giatna kumin, Abiyah pen Yahdah-te kumpi a suak hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Yerusalem ah kum thum sung uk hi. A nu’ min pen Maachah hi a, Abishalom’ tunu ahi hi.
Ama mai-a a pa gamtat mawhna khempeuh ama’n a zui hi. A pa David’ lungsim bangin Yahweh a Pa lamah ama lungsim bukim zo lo hi.
Ahi zongin David’ hangin Yahweh a Pa in ama a zom ding tapa khat khansakna leh Yerusalem kipsakna tawh Yerusalem sungah meivak khat amah pia hi—
bang hang hiam cihleh David in Yahweh muhna ah a manin gamta a, Hit mi Uriyah thu ah simloh a nuntak sung tawntungin Yahweh in amah a thupiakna peuhpeuh panin a pial kei hi.
Abiyah nuntak sung teng Rehoboam leh Yeroboam kikalah gal kidona a om hi.
Tu-in Abiyah uk sunga thupiang adangte leh a sepsa khempeuh, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam? Tu-in Abiyah leh Yeroboam kikalah gal kidona om hi.
Tua ciangin Abiyah a pate tawh ihmu-in, amaute in David Khuapi sungah a vui uh hi. Tua khit ciangin a tapa Asa in a kumpi’ za luah hi.
Israyl kumpi Yeroboam’ uk zawh a kum sawmnih kumin, Asa pen Yahdah-te kumpi a suak hi.
Amah in Yerusalem ah kum 41 sung uk hi. A pi’ min pen Maachah hi a, Abishalom’ tunu ahi hi.
Asa in a pa David gamtat bangin Yahweh muhna ah a manin gamta hi.
Amah in a gam sung panin pasal kizuakte hawlkhia-in a pate bawlsa pasiante (elohim) khempeuh a hemkhia hi.

Amah in kumpinu’ nu dinmun panin a pi Maachah zong hemkhia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuanu in pawite bawl nadingin a huathuai Asherah Khuam a bawl hi. Asa in tua khuam phuktanin, Kidron Kuam sungah a haltum hi.
Mun sangte kihemkhia lo hi; ahih hangin a nuntak sung tawntungin Asa’ lungsim Yahweh lamah bukim hi.
Amah leh a pa’ apsa ngun, kham leh nazatte khempeuh amah in Yahweh’ Inn sungah a paipih hi.
A nuntak sung tengun Asa leh Israyl kumpi Baasha kikalah gal kidona om hi.
Israyl kumpi Baasha in Yahdah simin, Yahdah kumpi Asa kiangah kuamah a pai loin kuamah a pusuah theih loh nadingin Ramah a lam hi.

Tua ciangin Asa in Yahweh’ Inn leh kumpi-inn-a van manpha koihnate-a a omlaite ahi ngun leh kham khempeuh la-in, a uliante’ khut sungah a pia hi. Tua khit ciangin kumpi Asa in Damascus-a teng Aram kumpipa Hezion’ tapa Tabrimmon’ tapa ahi Ben-Hadad kiangah amaute sawlin, a gen inah:

“Na pa leh ka pa kikala kipawlna a om mah bangin nang leh kei kikalah omsak ni. En in, keimah in ngun leh kham letsong khat nang kong khak hi. Tu-in kei kiang panin Israyl kumpi Baasha a nungkik nadingin amah tawh na thuciam pel in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi Asa tawh Ben-Hadad thukim a, Israyl khuapite langpanin a galkap ukte a sawl hi. Amah in Iyon, Dan, Abel Beth Maacah, leh Naphtali gam khempeuh tawh Kinneret-a khempeuh a zo hi.
Baasha kiangah hih thu a kikoh ciangin, amah in Ramah a lamna panin tawpin, Tirzah ah a kik hi.

Tua ciangin Kumpi Asa in Yahdah gam sung khempeuh ah thupia-in khat beek pengsak lo hi. Baasha in a zat suangte leh singluangte, amaute in Ramah panin puakhia uh a, kumpipa Asa in tuate tawh Benyamin-a Geba leh Mizpah a lam hi.

Asa’ uk hun sunga thupiang dangte khempeuh, a vangliatna khempeuh, a sepsa khempeuh leh kulhpi tawh a um khuapite, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam? Ahi zongin a tek ciangin a khe ah natna a vei hi.
Tua ciangin Asa a pate tawh ihmu-in, a pa David Khuapi sungah a pate tawh a kivui hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahshaphat in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Tu-in Yahdah kumpi Asa uk zawh a kum nihna kumin Yeroboam’ tapa Nadab Israyl-te kumpi suak a, amah in Israyl kum nih sung a uk hi.
Yahweh muhna ah amah a sia-in gamta a, a pa lampi leh Israyl-te a khialhsakna ama mawhna mah a zui hi.
Tua ciangin Issachar innkuan-a Ahiyah’ tapa Baasha in amah a sawmsim hi. Nadab leh Israyl khempeuh in Philistia-te khua Gibbethon a umcih laitakun Baasha in Gibbethon ah amah a that hi.
Baasha in Yahdah kumpi Asa uk zawh a kum thumna kumin Nadab that a, a kumpi’ za luah hi.

Gam uk ding a kipat phetin, amah in Yeroboam innkuan buppi a that hi. Yahweh in Shilon mi a nasempa Ahiyah tungtawnin a gen Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in a vekpi-in a suksiat khit dongin amah in Yeroboam innkuan sunga husang khat beek a siit kei hi.
Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa a heh nadingin thangpaihsakna tawh ama langdona hangin Yeroboam khialhna leh Israyl-te a khialhsakna ahi Yeroboam’ mawhnate hang ahi hi.
Nadab’ uk hun sunga thupiang adangte leh a sepsa khempeuh, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
2 Amau nuntak sung teng Asa leh Baasha kikalah gal kidona om hi.
Yahdah kumpi Asa’ uk zawh a kum thumna kumin Ahiyah’ tapa Baasha Tirzah ah Israyl-te khempeuh kumpi suak a, kum 24 sung a uk hi.
Yahweh muhna ah amah a sia-in gamta a, Yeroboam’ lampi leh Israyl-te a khialsak Yeroboam’ mawhna mah a zui hi.
Baasha langpangin Hanani’ tapa Yahu tungah Yahweh kammal hong tungin a gen inah:

“Leivui panin nang kong laamto a, Ka mi Israyl-te tungah a ukpa kong suaksak hi; ahih hangin amaute mawhna hangin Kei nong hehsak nadingin nangmah in Yeroboam’ lampi zui-in, Ka mi Israyl-te a mawh nadingin na khialsak hi.
En in, Keimah in Baasha leh a innkuante ka ne tum ding a, Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam’ innkuan bangin nangma innkuan ka bawl ding hi.
Khuapi sunga Baasha mi a sipa uite in ne ding hi. Gamlaka a sipa huihlaka sasial ne vasate in ne ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Baasha’ uk hun sunga thupiang dangte, a septe leh a vangliatna, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Baasha a pate tawh ihmu-in, Tirzah ah a kivui hi. Tua khit ciangin a tapa Elah in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.

Tua tham loin Yeroboam’ innkuan bangin a pian nadingin ama khut tawh a sepna in Yahweh a hehsakna hangin Yahweh muhna ah ama bawl siatna khempeuh hang leh amah in amah; Nadab, a thahna hangin Hanani’ tapa kamsang Yahu tungtawnin Baasha leh a innkuante langpangin Yahweh kammal a tung hi.
Yahdah kumpi Asa’ uk zawh a kum sawmnih le gukna kumin, Baasha’ tapa Elah Israyl-te tungah kumpi suak a, amah in Tirzah ah kum nih sung a uk hi.
Tu-in a sakolleengte alang a uk a ulianpa Zimri in Tirzah ah a om laitakin amah sawm sim a, Tirzah-a a innsung ukpa Arza’ inn sungah zu a kham hi.
Yahdah kumpi Asa’ uk zawh a kum sawmnih le sagihna kumin Zimri pai-in amah do-in that a, tua ciangin a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
A kumpi-tokhom tungah tu-in a ukna a kipat phetin amah in Baasha’ innkuan khempeuh a that hi; amah in pasal khat nangawn, a nasem sung pan ahi a, a lawmte lak pan ahi zongin siit lo hi.
Yahweh in kamsang Yahu tungtawnin Baasha langah a gensa Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in hi bangin Zimri in Baasha’ innkuan khempeuh a netum hi;
a pasiante (elohim) uh tawh Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa a heh nadingin Israyl-te a khialhsakna uh leh, Baasha leh a tapa Elah in a khialh uh mawhnate khempeuh hang ahi hi.
Elah’ uk hun sunga thupiang dangte leh a sepsa khempeuh Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Yahdah kumpi Asa’ uk zaw a kum sawmnih le sagihna kumin, Tirzah ah Zimri in kum sagih sung uk hi. Philistia-te khua khat ahi Gibbethon gei-ah galkapte in giahphual a sat uh hi.

Tu-in tua lai-a giahphual a sat mite in, “Zimri in kumpipa sawmsimin, that khin hi,” cih thu a za uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua ni-in Israyl khempeuh in giahphual sunga Israyl khempeuh tungah kumpi-in galkap mangpa Omri a bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin Tirzah umcih dingin Omri leh amah tawh a om Israyl khempeuh Gibbethon panin a kuankhia uh hi.
Khuapi a kilak khit lam Zimri in a theih ciangin, kumpi-inn sunga inn muanhuai sungah lutin, a kiimkota kumpi-inn a hal hi. Amah zong si hi—
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh muhna ah a sia gamtatna, Yeroboam’ lampi zuihna leh ama gamtat mawhna sungah Israylte a khialhsakna tawh a mawhna gamtatnate hang ahi hi.
Tu-in Zimri’ uk hun sunga ama sepna a omlai teng leh a gam a lehhekna-te Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Israyl mite kikhenin khen nih suak uh hi: mipi alang in Omri a zuih laitakun mipi alang mah in Ginath’ tapa Tibni zui-in kumpi a suaksak nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin Ginath’ tapa Tibni a zuite sangin Omri a zui mipite thahatzaw uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Tibni si a, Omri in a uk hi.
Yahdah kumpi Asa’ uk zawh a kum sawmthum le khatna kumin, Omri Israyl kumpi suakin kum 12 sung a uk hi. Amah in Tirzah ah kum guk a uk hi.
Amah in Shemer kiang panin Samaria mualtung ngun talent nih; pound 150 kiim, tawh lei-in mual tungah khuapi khat lam a, a mual neipa Shemer’ min puasakin a min Samaria; Shomeron, a phuak hi.
Yahweh’ mit ah Omri a sia-in gamta a, ama mai-a khempeuh nangawn sangin a siazaw-in a gamta hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in pasiante (elohim) tawh Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa a heh nadingin Nebot’ tapa Yeroboam’ lampite leh Israyl-te a khialhsakna ama mawhna mah a zui hi.
Tu-in Omri’ uk hun sunga a sepsa thupiang adangte leh a lahkhiat ama vangliatna-te Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Omri a pate tawh ihmu-in Samaria ah a kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Ahab in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yahdah kumpi Asa’ uk zawh a kum sawmthum le giatna kumin, Omri’ tapa Ahab Israyl kumpi a suak hi. Omri’ tapa Ahab in Samaria ah Israyl-te kum 22 sung a uk hi.
Tu-in Omri’ tapa Ahab in Yahweh muhna ah ama mai-a khempeuh nangawn sangin a siazaw-in a gamta hi.

Ama aa dingin Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam’ mawhnate bangmah tham hi nai lo bek tham loin, amah in Sidon mite’ kumpipa Ethbaal’ tanu Yezebel; Baalzebel, zong a tenpih lai hi; tua ciangin amah in Baal; Topa, nung zui-in, amah bia-in a na a sem hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Samaria-a a lamsa Baal’ Inn sungah Baal; Topa, aa dingin biaknatau khat a dingsak hi.
Tua ciangin Ahab in Asherah Khuam khat zong a bawl hi. Amah in ama mai-a Israyl kumpi khempeuh sangin Israyl’ Pa Yahweh a hehzawk nadingin a gamta hi.

Ama nuntak sungin Beth-El a Hiel in Yericho a lamkik hi. Yahweh in Nun’ tapa Yahshua tungtawna a gen Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in amah in a tapa upa pen Abiram’ luang khamin a bulpi phut a, a tapa neupen Segub’ luang khamin a kongpite a phut hi.

Tu-in Gilead-a a tengthak Tishbe mi Yliyah in Ahab kiangah, “Ama mai-a ka dinna pa, Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa a nungta ahih manin tu kumte sungah keima thu loin daitui ahi a, guahtui ahi zongin om lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin ama kiangah Yahweh’ kammal hong tungin,
“Hih teng nusia inla, nisuahna lamah kihei in. Yardan dongah a luang Cherith Lui kiangah bu in.
Nangmah in tua lui panin tui na dawn thei ding a, tua lai-ah nang hong vak dingin Arab-te thu ka piakhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah dingkhia-in Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in a gamta hi—amah pai-in, Yardan nisuahna lama om Cherith Lui kiangah a om hi.
Arab-te in zingsangin anlum leh sa puakin, nitakin anlum leh sa puak a, amah in lui panin tui a dawn hi.
Gam sungah guah zu lo ahih manin hun khat khit ciangin tua lui a kang hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yliyah kiangah Yahweh’ kammal hong tungin a gen inah:
“Tho inla, Sidon gama Zarephath ah pai-in tua lai-ah teng in. En in, tua lai-ah nang hong sik dingin meigong khat thu ka piakhin hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah tho-in, Zarephath ah a pai hi. Khuapi kongpi ah amah a tun ciangin, singtom meigong khat a mu hi. Amah in tuanu otsanin, “Tui ka dawn dingin hai sungah tui tawm khat hong paipih in,” a ci hi.
Tui la dingin tuanu a pai laitakin amah in tuanu kiangah, “Tua ciang na khut sungah anlum tawmkhat hong paipih lai in,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin tuanu in, “Yahweh na Pa a nungta ahih mah bangin kong cih inah anlum ka nei kei hi—beel sungah annel khut dim khat leh um sungah sathau tawmno khat bek om hi. Keimah pai-in, kei leh ka tapa aa dingin tuate bawlin ka nek theih nadingun keimah in sing tawmno khat a tom ka hi a, tua khit ciangin ka si ta ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Yliyah in ama kiangah, “Lau kei in. Pai inla, na cih bangin hih in. Tua panin kei aa dingin moh neu khat hong bawlsak masa inla, kei kiangah hong paipih in. Tua khit ciangin nang leh na tapa aa dingin bawl in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh, Israyl Pa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Leitung ah Yahweh in guah a zuksak ni matengin annel beel sunga annel bei lo ding a, na sathau um keu lo ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuanu pai-in, Yliyah in amah a hilh bangin a hih hi; tuanu, amah leh tuanu’ innkuan in hun sawtpi sung a ne uh hi.
Yliyah tungtawnin Amah in a gen Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in annel beel sunga annel bei lo a, sathau um zong a keu kei hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin inn nei nupinu’ tapa a ci na hi. A natna nasia semsemin a hu a bei hi.
Tuanu in Yliyah kiangah, “Yahweh’ mipa aw, kei tungah bang lungkim lohna nei na hi hiam? Ka mawhnate hong phawksak kik ding leh ka tapa that dinga hong pai na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in tuanu kiangah, “Na tapa hong pia in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in tuanu ang panin la-in ama omna inn tung dei-ah paipihto-in a lupna tungah a sial hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh tungah amah kiko-in, “Yahweh ka Pa aw, a tapa sihsakna tawh ka omna hih meigongnu tungah zong dahluatna tungsak na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin naupangno tungah amah thumvei kikhuangin Yahweh tungah kiko a, “Yahweh aw, kong thuum hi; hih naupang’ nuntakna ama tungah kilehkiksak in!” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh’ in Yliyah’ kikona za-in, naupangno’ nuntakna ama tungah tungkikin a nungta hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yliyah in naupangno la-in inn tung dei panin inn sungah paipih sukin, a nu kiangah a pia hi. Yliyah in, “En in, na tapa nungta hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin nupinu in Yliyah kiangah, “Tu-in hih thu hangin nang pen Yahweh’ mipa na hihna leh na kam pana Yahweh’ kammal a manna thu ka thei hi,” a ci hi.
Hun sawtpi khit, kum thum ciangin Yliyah tungah Yahweh’ kammal hong tung a, “Pai inla, Ahab tungah va kipia tawm in; tua ciangin Keimah in leitung ah guah ka zusak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ahab tungah amahmah kipia tawm dingin Yliyah pai hi. Samaria gam sungah kialpi a nasia mahmah hi;
Tua ciangin Ahab in a inn sung uk ahi Obadyah a sam hi. (Tu-in Obadyah in Yahweh nakpi takin zahtak a,
Yezebel in Yahweh’ kamsangte a thahthah lai-in, Obadyah in kamsang za khat la-in kuahawm nih sungah sawmnga ta-in busak a, an leh tui tawh a vak hi.)

Ahab in Obadyah kiangah, “Gam sung khempeuh, tuinak omna khempeuh leh luitui omna khempeuh ah va pai in. I sakolte leh i laate a nungta-in i kep theih nadingin lopa na va mu thei kha ding hi; tua hileh i ganhingte khatpeuh i thahlup kul lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a zonkim theih nadingun gam hawm uh a, Ahab mun khat lamah pai-in, Obadyah a mun dang khat lamah a pai hi.
Obadyah a paina lamah a pai laitakin Yliyah tawh a kituak uh hi. Obadyah in amah thei-in, mai kunsuk a, “Ka ukpa Yliyah, nangmah na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Ka hi mah hi. Pai inla, na ukpa kiangah, ‘Yliyah hiah om hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, “Kei hong thah nadingin Ahab khut sungah na nasempa nong piak nadingin bang mawhna nei ka hi hiam?

Yahweh na Pa a nungta ahih mah bangin nang hong zong dingin ka ukpa in a sawl loh minam leh kumpigam khat beek om lo hi. Minam khatpeuh ahi a, kumpigam khatpeuh in ahi zongin tua lai-ah nang na om loh lam a tangko uh ciangin, amah in amau genna thu a man ahihna a kiciamsak hi.
Tua hi a, tu-in nang in kei kiangah, ‘Pai inla, na ukpa kiangah, ‘Yliyah hiah om hi,’ ci in,’ nong ci lai hi.

Tua hi a, nang kong nusiat khit phetin Yahweh’ Kha in ka theih ngei lohna mun ah nang hong puak ding hi; tua hileh keimah pai-in Ahab ka zaksak ciangin, amah in nang hong mu lo ding a, amah in kei hong that ding hi. Ahi zongin na nasempa keimah in ka khangno lai-a kipanin Yahweh ka zahtak hi.

Yerebel; Baalzebel, in Yahweh’ kamsangte a that lai-in, Yahweh’ kamsang zakhat, kuahawm khat ah sawmngata busakin, an leh tui tawh amaute ka sikna thu—ka gamtatna ka ukpa kiangah hong kiko lo ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin tu-in nangmah in, ‘Pai inla, na ukpa kiangah, ‘Yliyah hiah om hi,’ ci-in gen in,’ na ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in kei hong that ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yliyah in, “Ama mai-a ka dinnapa Vanglianpen Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin tuni-in ama tungah a kipia tawm taktak ding ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ahab zong dingin Obadyah pai-in, ama kiangah a ko hi. Tua ciangin Yliyah a mu dingin Ahab a pai hi.
Ahab in Yliyah a muh ciangin, Ahab in ama kiangah, “Israyl a buaisakpa nangmah na hia?” ci-in a dong hi.

Ahih hangin amah in, “Keimah in Israyl ka buaisak kei hi. Nang leh na pa’ innkuan in Israyl a buaisak uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in Yahweh’ Thukhamte taisanin, Baalim; Topate, Pasiante (Elohim), leh Nusiante, nung na zui hi.

Tu-in kei kiang Carmel Mual ah Israyl khempeuh samin kaikhawm inla, Baal kamsang 450 leh Yezebel’; Baalzebel’, sabuai-a an a ne Asherah’; Ishtar, Easter’, kamsang 400-te zong sam in,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Ahab in Israyl mi khempeuh kiangah thu puakin, Carmel Mual tungah kamsangte khempeuh a khawm hi.

Yliyah in mi khempeuh tungah thugenin, “Upna guipi kibang lo nih ah na kiveiveina uh cik ciangin khawl ding na hi uh hiam? Yahweh pen Vanglianpa ahih leh, amah zui pah un! Ahih keileh Baal; Topa, pen vanglianpa ahih leh, amah zui pah un!” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yliyah in mite kiangah, “Yahweh’ kamsangte khempeuh lak panin kei bek ka om lai hi; ahih hangin Baal kamsangte pen 450 pha hi.

Tu-in kote aa dingin bawngtal nih hong sik unla, amau aa dingin khat teelsak un. Amaute in semnenin sing tungah koih uh henla, ahih hangin mei tawh hal kei uh hen. Keimah in a bawngtal khatzaw ka bawl ding a, sing tungah koihin, ahih hangin mei tawh ka hal kei ding hi.

Tua ciangin no na pasian min uh Baal; Topa, sam unla, tua ciangin keimah in Yahweh’ Min ka sam ding hi. Mei-a hong dawng Vanglianpa om ding a—Amah pen Vanglianpa ahi hi,” a ci hi. Mi khempeuh in dawngin, “Na gen thu in man hi” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yliyah in Baal kamsangte kiangah, “No tam mahmah na hih manun bawngtal khat teel masa unla, no aa dingin bawl un. Na pasian uh Baal’ min sam unla ahih hangin a nuai-ah mei hal kei un,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute in amau aa dingin a kisik bawngtal la-in a bawl uh hi. Tua khit ciangin amaute in zingsang panin sunkim dong Baal’ min sam uh hi. Amaute in, “Baal; Topa, aw! Hong za in!” a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin kidawng lo a, khat beek in dawng lo hi. Tua ciangin amaute in a bawlsa uh biaknatau kiimkotah khebai bangin a pai uh hi.

Sunkim ciangin Yliyah in amaute zahpih kipanin, “Nak ot lai ve vua! Amah pasian ahih nungsangin, amah in thu nak ngaihsut lua ahih keileh, buai lua ahih keileh khualzin hi kha ding hi! A ihmu laitak hi kha ding hi, phot loh phamawh ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiko phasem uh a, amau ngeina bangin temta leh sikzum tawh a sisan luan dongun a kikui uh hi.
Sunkim bei-in nitak lam biakpiakna hun dong amaute in thu ngen suak uh a, ahih hangin kidawng lo a, khat beek in dawng loin, kuamah in a thusim kei hi.

Tua ciangin Yliyah in mi khempeuh kiangah, “Tu-in ka kiangah hong pai un!” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh ama kiang nai-ah hong pai uh hi. A kiangah amaute hong tungin, amah in a kisiasa Yahweh’ biaknatau a puahpha hi.
Yliyah in suangtum sawm le nih la a, khat ai ciangin, ‘Israyl pen nangma min hi ding hi’ ci-in Yahweh’ kammal a tunnapa Yaaqob’ tapate ahi minamte khat ciat aitang ding ahi hi.
Tua suangte tawh amah in Yahweh’ Minin biaknatau khat lam a, tua biaknatau kiimkotah khaici seah nih a ta zo ding hawkguam khat to hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in biaknatau tungah hoihtakin a singte gual a, tua ciangin bawngtal semnenin sing tungah a koih hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in, “Beel li sungah tui dim unla, biakna tung leh sing tungah buak un!” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in, “Hihkik lai un!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in a nihveina a hih uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “A thumveina hih lai un!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in a thumveina a hih lai uh hi.
Biaknatau kiimkot khempeuh ah tui luangkhia-in a hawkguam ah tui a dim hi.

Biakpiakna a piak ding tak ciangin, kamsang Yliyah kalsuan phei-in, “Abraham, Isaac leh Israyl-te’ Pa Yahweh aw, Nang pen Israyl sunga Vanglian Pa na hihna, Keimah in na nasempa ka hihna leh, Nangma kammal bangin hih nate khempeuh ka sep ahihna tuni-in kitheikhiasak in.
Hong dawng in, Yahweh aw, hong dawng in! Tua hileh nang in Vanglianpen Yahweh na hihna leh amau’ lungsimte a heikik dingpa na hihna hih mite in thei ding uh hi,” ci-in thu a ngen hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ mei hong kia-in, biakpiakna, singte, suangte, leh a leite kangtum a, hawkguam sunga om tui zong a liak siang hi.
Mi khempeuh in hih thu a muh uh ciangin, amau maipuk-in kiko uh a, “Yahweh, Amah pen Vanglian Pa hi! Yahweh, Amah pen Pa hi” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yliyah in amaute thupia-in, “Baal kamsangte man un. Amaute khat beek suaktasak kei un!” a ci hi. Amaute in manin, tua ciangin Yliyah in Kishon Lui ah amaute paipihsukin, tua lai-ah amaute a that hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yliyah in Ahab kiangah, “Guah tampi hong zu ding ahih manin pai inla, ne-in dawn in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Carmel dawn ah Yliyah a paitoh laitakin, a ne a dawn dingin Ahab a pai hi. Tua lai leilak ah Yliyah kunsukin, a khukte kikalah a maitang a phum hi.
Amah in a nasempa kiangah, “Pai inla, tuipi lam en in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah paito-in khuadak a, ahih hangin amah in, “Bangmah omlo hi,” a ci hi. Yliyah in, “Paikik in,” sagihvei a ci hi.

A sagihveina ciangin a nasempa in, “En in, pasal khat’ khuttum zah-a neu meii khat tuipi panin hong kaito hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yliyah in, “Pai inla, Ahab kiangah, ‘Guah in hong khak ma-in na sakolleeng vawh inla, paisuk in,’ va ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua sungtengin meii kai-in van vom a, huih nung a, guahpi hong zu hi; tua ciangin Ahab a leeng tungah tuangin Yezreel ah a tung hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yliyah tungah Yahweh’ vangliatna hong tungin, amah in a puantualpi a kawng ah gakin Yezreel khua lutna dong Ahab’ mai-ah a na tai hi.
Yliyah hihna khempeuh leh amah in kamsang khempeuh namsau tawh a thahna thu, Ahab in Yezebel kiangah a gen hi.

Tua ciangin Yliyah kiangah Yezebel in kamtai khat sawlin, “Zingciang tu bang hunin amaute khat bangin na nuntakna ka hih kei tak leh, kei tungah pasiante (elohim) in hih bangin hong bawl henla, tua sang a nasiazaw-in zong hong bawl tahen!” a ci hi.
Yliyah in hih thu a muh ciangin, dingin a nuntak nadingin a tai hi. Yahdah gam Beersheba ah amah pai-in a nasempa tua lai-ah nusia a,

ahih hangin sehnel gam sungah ni khat lampaina tan a pai hi. Poding kung nuai khat ah amah tungin tusuk a, a sihna dingin thu ngenin, “Phazo hi! Tu-in Yahweh aw ka nuntakna la in; bang hang hiam cihleh ka pate sangin ka hoihzaw kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah sing nuai-ah lumin, a ihmu hi. Thakhat thu-in vantungmi khat in amah lawngin ama kiangah, “Tho inla, ne in!” a ci hi.
Amah khuadak a, a lukhung gei-ah meiholsa tunga ki-em moh khat leh tui thawl khat a na om hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in ne-in dawnin a lumkik hi.
Yahweh’ vantungmi a nihveina hong pai-in amah lawng a, “Tho inla, ne in; bang hang hiam cihleh nang aa dingin khualzinna gim huai lua hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah tho-in ne-in dawn a, tua an tha tawh Yahweh’ mual Horeb ciang dong sun sawmli leh zan sawmli sung a pai hi.
Kuahawm sung khat ah amah lutin, tua mun ah zan a giak hi. Tua ciangin en in, ama kiangah Yahweh’ kammal hong tung a, Amah in ama kiangah, “Yliyah aw, hih lai-ah bang hih na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Amah in, “Israyl mite in Na thuciamna nusia-in, Na biaknataute balkhia uh a, namsau tawh Na kamsangte that uh ahih manin Vanglianpen Yahweh ka Pa aa dingin ka aam mahmah hi. Keimah bek a omlai ka hi a, tu-in amaute in kei thah ding hanciam uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Yahweh in Yliyah hilh a, “Pusuak inla, mual tung Yahweh mai-ah ding in. Tua ciangin en in, Yahweh in nawkin, lianin a thakhauh huihpi in mualtungte semkhamin, Yahweh mai-a suangte a kitamzan a, ahih hangin tua huih lakah Yahweh om lo hi. Huihpi a nun khit ciangin zin ling a, ahih hangin zinling sungah Yahweh om lo hi.
Zin a lin khit ciangin meikuang om a, ahih hangin meikuang sungah Yahweh om lo hi. Meikuang a om khit ciangin, awnem neu khat ging a,

Yliyah in tua aw a zak ciangin, a puantualpi; tallit, tawh a mai tun a, amah paikhia-in kuahawm lutna ah a ding hi. Tua khit ciangin aw khat in ama kiangah, “Hih lai-ah bang hih na hi hiam, Yliyah aw? A ci hi.

Amah in, “Israyl mite in Na thuciamna nusia-in, Na biaknataute balkhia uh a, namsau tawh Na kamsangte that uh ahih manin Vanglianpen Yahweh ka Pa aa dingin ka aam mahmah hi. Keimah bek a omlai ka hi a, tu-in amaute in kei thah ding hanciam uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Nong paina lampi ah paikik inla, Damascus Sehnel gam ah pai in. Tua lai-ah na tun ciangin, Aram-te tungah kumpi-in Hazael sathau nilh in.
Tua khit ciangin Israyl tungah kumpi dingin Nimshi’ tapa Yahu sathau nilh inla, nang’ za hong laih ding kamsang dingin Abel Meholah-a Shaphat’ tapa Ylisha zong sathau nilh in.
Tua ciangin Hazael’ namsau panin a suaktate Yahu in that ding a, Yahu’ namsau panin a suaktate Ylisha in a that hun hong tung ding hi.
Tua hi napi-in Baal mai-ah a khukdin ngei lo, a muk uh tawh amah a tawp ngei lo—Israyl sungah a omlai tul sagih ka nei hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yliyah in tua lai nusia-in pai a, Shaphat’ tapa Ylisha a lokaih laitak a mu hi. Ama mai-ah bawngtal kap sawm le kap nih om a, amah pen a kap sawm le nihna tawh a om hi. Ama kiangah Yliyah pai-in a kiim ah a puantualpi a lawn hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in a bawngtalte nusia-in Yliyah nungdelh a, “Ka nu leh ka pa ka nap ding hong phal lai-in, tua ciangin na nung kong zui ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Pai in! Nang tungah kong bawlsa thu theih na hih manin hong paikik in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Ylisha in amah nusia-in, a paikik hi. Amah in a bawngtal-a hakkol la-in a bawngte a that hi. A bawng’ van teng tawh amah in sa huanin, mite pia a, amaute in a ne uh hi. Tua khit ciangin amah dingto a, Yliyah zui-in ama’ na a sem hi.
Tu-in Aram kumpi Ben-Hadad in a galkap khempeuh khawmin, sakolte leh sakolleengte a nei kumpi sawmthum le nih amah tawh a om hi. Amah kuanto-in Samaria umcih a, a sim hi.
Amah in khuapi sung Israyl kumpi Ahab kiangah kamtaite sawlin, ama kiangah, “Hih in Ben-Hadad’ thugen ahi hi:
Na ngun leh na khamte kei aa hi. Na zi hoihpente leh na tate kei aa hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in dawngin, “Ka ukpa, ka kumpipa aw, na gen bang ahi hi: kei leh ka neih khempeuh nang aa ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kamtaite hong paikikin, “Hih in Ben-Hadad’ thugen ahi hi: Hi hi, nang kiangah mi kong sawlin, ‘Nangmah in na ngun leh na khamte, na zite leh na tate kei kiangah nong pia ding hi,’ kong ci uh hi;

ahih hangin zingciang tuhunin na inn leh na uliante’ innte a pheklek ding ka uliante nang kiangah kong sawl ding hi. Tua ciangin na thupitsakpen peuhmah amaute in hong matsakin, puakhia mang ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in gam sung upate khempeuh samin, “En dih un, hih mipa in buaina a zon dan; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in ka ngun leh ka khamte, ka zite leh ka tate hong kalh hangin ka nial kei hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin upate khempeuh leh mipi khempeuh in ama kiangah, “A thu ngai kei inla, ama hong kalhte zong thukim kei in,” a ci uh hi.

Hih thu hangin amah in Ben-Hadad’ kamtaite kiangah, “Ka uk kumpipa kiangah gen un: A masa-a nong kalhna khempeuh ka hih ding hi; ahih hangin hih thu bel ka hih zo kei ding hi, ci un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin kamtaite pai-in, Ben-Hadad kiangah hih thu a puak uh hi.

Tua ciangin Ben-Hadad in ama kiangah hih kamtaipa sawlkikin, “Ka mite khat ciat tungah khut dim khatta piak dingin Samaria gam sungah leivui a kicingin a omlai tak leh, pasiante (elohim) in kei tungah a ututin hong bawlin tua sang a nasiazaw-in zong hong bawl tahen!” a ci hi.
Israyl kumpipa in dawngkikin, “Amah gen in: gal a zawh ciangin galvan a suahkhiapa bangin galvan tawh a kithawipa kisa thei kei hen,” a ci hi.

Amah leh kumpite in succoth; ompakna bukte, sungah zu dawnin a om laitakun, Ben-Hadad in hih thupuakna a za hi. Tua ciangin amah in a mite kiangah, “Galsim dingin kithawi un!” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin khuapi sim dingin amaute a kithawi uh hi.

En in, Israyl kumpi Ahab kiangah kamsang khat pai-in, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Hih mihon tampi khempeuh na mu ngei hiam? En in, tuni-in nang tungah amaute kong pia ding a, tua ciangin kei pen Yahweh ka hihna nong thei ding hi!” a ci hi.

Ahab in, “Kua in hih thu sem ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Gamte a uk galkapmang khangmoi-te in sem ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Kua in galsimna pan masa ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Nang na pan ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in gamte a uk galkapmang khangmoite sam a, amaute 232 a pha uh hi. Amau khit ciangin amah in Israyl mi khempeuh ahi mipi khempeuh khawmin 7,000 a pha hi.
Ben-Hadad leh amah tawh a om kumpi 32-te in a succoth; omna pak bukte, sungah zu a kham laitakun amaute sunkim lianin kuankhia uh hi.
Gamte a uk galkapmang khangmoite kuankhia masa uh hi. Tu-in Ben-Hadad in galvil thukansimte sawlkhin a, amaute in ama kiangah, “Samaria panin mi hong kuankhia uh hi,” ci-in a ko uh hi.
Amah in, “Kilemna bawl dingin amaute hong pai ahih uhleh, a hingin man un! Gal kido dingin hong pai ahih leh zong, a hingin man un!” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Khuapi panin gamte a uk hih galkapmang khangmoite kuankhia-in amaute nungah galkapte in a zui uh hi.

Mi khempeuh in amau kisikpih ciat that uh ahih manin Aram mite taimang uh a, Israyl-te in a nungdelh uh hi. Ahih hangin Aram kumpi Ben-Hadad a sakol tungah tuangin a sakolsiam mi pawlkhat tawh a suakta uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa kuankhia-in sakolte leh sakolleengte zogawpin, Aram mite tungah supna lianpi a tungsak uh hi.

Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa kiangah kamsangpa hong pai-in, ama kiangah, “Pai inla, na dinmun khosak in. Na hih loh a phamawh thu limtakin ngaihsun inla ciamteh in; bang hang hiam cihleh khuakhal ciangin Aram kumpipa hong kuanto ding a, nang hong sim ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Aram kumpipa’ uliante in ngaihsutna pulakin kuppih uh a, “Amau pasiante pen mualtung pasiante ahi hi. Hih thu hangin ei sangin amau thahatzaw uh hi. Ahi zongin eite in lei tamzang ah amaute sim le hang amaute sangin i thahatzaw taktak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hi cih in: kumpite let thupiaknate khawlsak inla, galkapbute tawh laih in.

Tua ciangin na taansa galkap tawh a kibang galkap, sakol tangin sakol, sakolleeng tangin sakolleeng kaikhawm in. Tua khit ciangin lei tamzang ah amaute i do ding a, amaute sangin i hatzaw taktak ding hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in amaute’ kuppihna leh a ngaihsut piakna sang thei-in amau cih bangin a hih hi.
Khuakhal hun ciangin Ben-Hadad in Aram mite khawmin, Israyl-te a do dingin Aphek ah a kuankhia uh hi.

Israyl mite kikhawmin lam-ante kiguan uh a, amaute tawh a kido dingin a kuankhia uh hi. Israyl mite in amaute galah keelhon neu nih bangin giahphual sat uh a, Aram mite ahih leh gam sung khempeuh ah dim uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh mipa hong pai-in, Israyl kumpipa kiangah a gen inah, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Aram mite in Yahweh’ pen khamgamte’ pasian khat hi a, zanggamte’ pasian hilo hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh ahih manin, keimah in na khut sungah hih mihon tampite kong pia ding a, tua ciangin nangmah in kei pen Yahweh ka hihna na thei ding hi.
Amaute in kigalsai-in ni sagih sung giahphual satin om uh a, a ni sagihna ni ciangin gal kidona kipan hi. Israyl mite in ni khat thu-in Aram-te khe galkap 100,000 that uh hi.
A omlai teng Aphek khuapi ah tai uh a, tua lai-ah kulh in amaute 27,000 a cipnelh hi. Tua hi a, Ben-Hadad zong tai-in khuapi sunga inndei sungnung khat ah a lut hi.

A uliante in ama kiangah, “Israyl innkuan kumpite pen hehpihna a nei kumpite hi, ci-in ka zakhin uh hi. Tu-in puanhampi silh tawmin, i lu ah khauhual vialin Israyl kumpipa kiangah va pai ni. Amah na nuntakna hong hawisak kha thei ding hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin a uliante in puanhampi silh tawm uh a, a lu uhah khauhualte gakin Israyl kumpipa kiangah a pai uh hi. Amaute in, “Na nasempa Ben-Hadad in, ‘Hong nungtasak in!’ ci hi” a ci uh hi. Ahab in, “Amah nungta lai ahi hiam? Amah pen ka sanggampa hi” ci-in hih tawh a dawng kik hi.

Amaute in ama kiang pana lim na encik uh hi. Amaute in ama kammalte siksanin, “Ben-Hadad pen na sanggampa mah hi!” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Ahab in, “Pai unla hong paipih un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin ama kiangah Ben-Hadad hong paikhia a, tua ciangin Ahab in amah a sakolleeng tungah a kahtohpih hi.

Tua ciangin Ben-Hadad in Ahab kiangah, “Na pa kiang pana ka pa’ laksak khuapite kong piakik ding hi; tua ciangin Samaria ah ka pa koih mah bangin nangmah in Damascus ah nang aa dingin sumbuk munte na koih thei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Ahab in, “Thukimna khat tawh nang kong khah ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Ahab in amah tawh thukimna khat bawlin, amah a khah hi.
Tu-in kamsangte’ tapate khat in Yahweh’ kammal tungtawnin a sanggampa kiangah, “Hong sat in!” a ci hi. Ahih hangin mipa in a sat nuam kei hi.

Tua ciangin amah in ama kiangah, “Nangmah in Yahweh’ thu mang lo nahih manin kei kiang panin na paikhiat phetin humpinelkai khat in nang hong that taktak ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah a paikhiat phetin, humpinelkai khat in amah bawhin a that lum hi.
Kamsangpa in mi dang khat mu-in, “Hong sat in!” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mipa in amah satin a liamsak hi.
Tua ciangin kamsangpa paikhia a, a mit tung puan tawh tuamin a mel selin lampi gei-ah kumpipa a ngak hi.

Kumpipa in a nawk ciangin kamsangpa in amah samin, “Na nasempa gal haksatna ah ka kuan a, mi khat in kei kiangah a galmatsa khat hong paipihin, ‘Hih mipa cing in. Thu khat peuhpeuh hangin amah na khahsuah leh ama nuntakna tangin nang nuntakna hi ding a, ahih keileh ngun talent khat na liau ding hi,’ hong ci hi.

Tu-in na nasempa hih lai, hua lai-ah ka manlah kalin mipa na taisim hi!” a ci hi. Israyl kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Tua in nangma thuak ding thukhenna ahi hi. Nangma thuak ding thukhenna mah na genkhia hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kamsangpa in a mit tunga a puan tawh a tuamna lakhia vat a, tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in amah kamsangte khat ahih lam a thei hi.

Kamsangpa in ama kiangah, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Suksiat siang dinga a kisehsa khat na khahkhia hi; ama nuntakna tangin nang nuntakna hi ding a, ama mite tangin nangma mite hi ding hi, ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israyl kumpipa a inn ah heh kawmsa maimialsa-in pai a, Samaria a tung hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin Yezreel khua mi Naboth in Samaria kumpipa Ahab tenna gei Yezreel ah leenggui lo khat a nei hi.

Ahab in Naboth kiangah, “Na leenggui pen keima inn zom-a om ahih manin anteh huan dingin ka neih theih nadingin na leenggui lo hong pia in. Keimah in tua tangin leenggui lo a hoihzaw khat tawh kong khek ding a, ahih keileh zong nang aa dingin a hoihzawk ding leh a man zah sum kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Naboth in Ahab kiangah, “Nangma tungah ka pu ka pa gamh kong piak ding pen Yahweh in hong kham hi!” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin “Ka pu ka pa gamh nang kong pia kei ding hi,” ci-in Yezreel khua mi Naboth’ dawnna hangin Ahab ama inn ah hehkawmsa maimialsa-in ciah hi. Tua ciangin amah a lupna tungah lumin, a mai hei a, an a ne nuam kei hi.
Ama kiangah a zi Yezebel; Baalzebel, pai-in, ama kiangah, “Bang hangin maimial na hi hiam? Bang hangin an ne lo na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Amah in tuanu kiangah, “Keimah in Yerzeel khua mi Naboth hopihin, ama kiangah, ‘Na leenggui lo hong zuak in, nang aa dingin a hoihzaw ahih leh zong tua tangin a hoihzaw leenggui lo khat kong pia ding hi,’ ka ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in kei hong dawngin, ‘Ka leenggui lo kong pia kei ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a zi Yezebel in ama kiangah, “Israyl kumpi bangin na gamtat ding ahi hi! Tho inla an ne in; Na lungsim taisak in. Keimah in Yezreel khua mi Naboth’ leenggui lo kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tuanu in Ahab’ min tawh laikhak gelhin, Ahab’ seal tawh seal a tum hi. Tuanu in Naboth tawh khuapi sungah a teng khawm upate leh mi thupite tungah tua laikhak a khak hi.
Amah in a laikhak sungah, “An tan ding thu zasak unla, mite mai a kisuk theih nading mun ah Naboth koih un.

Tua ciangin amah tawh kigalsai-in Belial’ tapate; mi gilote, nih koih inla, tua ciangin amaute in, ‘Nangmah in Pasian (Elohim) leh kumpipa na samsiakhin hi!’ ci-in ze-et ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin amah kaikhia unla, suang tawh a sih dongin deng un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yezebel in amaute tunga a khaksa a laikhak sunga kigelh bang teekteek Yezebel lahsa bangin a khuapih mite, upate leh a khuapi sunga teng mi thupite in a hih uh hi.
Amaute in an tan ding thu zasakin Naboth suk theih na ding mun ah koih uh a,

amah tawh kigalsai-in Belial’ tapa nihte pai-in, mipite mai-ah amah langpangin teci pang uh a, “Naboth in Pasian (Elohim) leh kumpipa samsiakhin hi!” a ci uh hi. Amaute in khua pualam ah amah paipihin, suangin a denglum uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in Yezebel kiangah thu puakin, “Naboth kidenglum khin ta a, amah si hi,” a ci uh hi.

Naboth suangin a kidenlup khitna thu Yezebel in a zak phetin, Yezebel in Ahab kiangah, “Ding inla Yezreel khua mi Naboth in nang hong zuak nop loh leenggui lo nang aa dingin la in. Naboth nungta nawn lo a, amah si ta hi!” a ci hi.
Naboth si hi, cih thu Ahab in a zak ciangin Ahab dingto-in Yezreel khua mi Naboth’ leenggui lo a luah dingin a paisuk hi.
Tua khit ciangin Tishbe mi Yliyah kiangah Yahweh’ kammal hong tungin a gen inah:
“Ding in! Samaria gama teng Israyl kumpipa Ahab tawh kimu dingin paisuk in. Naboth’ leenggui lo a luah dingin a paina mun Naboth’ leenggui lo tua lai-ah amah na om ding hi.

Nangmah in ama kiangah, ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Mi khat thatin tu-in a neihsa matsak khin hilo na hi hiam?’ ci in. Tua khit ciangin nangmah in ama kiangah, ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Uite in Naboth’ sisan a liahna mun ah, nangma sisan zong uite in liak ding hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Ahab in Yliyah kiangah, “Ka galpa aw, kei kiangah hong pai na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Yahweh mit ah siatna a bawl dingin nang le nang kizuak na hih manin nang kianga hong pai ka hi hi!” a ci hi.
En in, nang tungah siatna kong tun ding hi. Na suanlekhakte ka hemkhia ding a, sila hitaleh sila lo hitaleh Israyl sunga Ahab’ suanlekhak pasal khempeuh ka beisak ding hi!
Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam’ innkuan leh Ahiyah’ tapa Baasha’ innkuan bangin na innkuan a thuaksak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in Kei nong hehsak a, Israyl-te mawhna na bawlsak hi.
Tua bangin Yezebel kiangah Yahweh in thugen a, Amah in, ‘Uite in Yezreel-a tua lo leitang ah Yezebel ne ding uh hi.
Khuapi sunga Ahab’ mi a sipa, uite in ne ding hi. Gamlaka a sipa, huihlak sasial ne vasate in ne ding uh hi.
(A zi Yezebel’ zawhsa-in Yahweh’ mit ah siatna a bawl dingin amahmah kizuak tawm Ahab tawh kibang mi khat beek om ngei nai lo hi.
Israyl mite mai panin Yahweh in a hawlkhiat Amor mite gamtat khempeuh bangin amah in pasiante (elohim) zuihna tawh a kihhuai mahmahin a gamta hi.)
Ahab in tua kammalte a zak ciangin, amah in a puante balkek a, puanhampi silhin an a tang hi. Puanhampi tungah lumin khakham vei-in a nitum hi.
Tua ciangin Tishbe mi Yliyah kiangah Yahweh’ kammal hong tungin a gen inah:

“Ka mai-ah Ahab bangci bangin a kiniam khiatna na mu nai hiam? Keima mai-ah amahmah kiniamkhiat khinzo ahih manin, ama nuntak sungin siatna ka tungsak kei ding hi. A tapa’ nuntak hun sungin ama innkuan tungah siatna ka tun ding hi,” a ci hi.
Aram leh Israyl kikal ah gal om loin kum thum a pai hi.
Tua ciangin a kum thumna kumin Israyl kumpipa tawh kimu dingin Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat a paisuk hi.
Israyl kumpipa in a uliante kiangah, “Gilead gam sunga Ramoth ei aa ahih lam na thei uh hi; ahih hangin Aram kumpipa’ khut panin i lak nadingin bangmah i hih kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah in Yahshaphat kiangah, “Ramoth Gilead sim dingin kei tawh nong kuan khawm ding hiam?” ci-in hih dotna a pia hi. Yahshaphat in, “Kei pen nang bang mah ka hi hi. Ka mite zong nangma mite bang mah ahi hi. Ka sakolte zong nangma sakol bang mah ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshaphat in Israyl kumpipa kiangah, “Ahih hangin tuni-in Yahweh kiangah thu dong masa in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Israyl kumpipa in kamsangte mihing 400 bang khawmin, amaute kiangah, “Ramoth Gilead sim dingin kuan ding ka hi hiam, ahih keileh omlai phot ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amaute khempeuh in amah dawngin, “Paito in! Adonai; Ka Topa, in kumpipa khut sungah hong pia ding hi!” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshaphat in, “Ama kiang i dot thei nadingin hih lai-ah Yahweh’ kamsang khat beek omlo ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Israyl kumpipa in Yahshaphat kiangah, “Ama tungtawnin Yahweh kiang thu i dot theih nadingin mi khat omlai hi; ahih hangin amah ka mudah hi, bang hang hiam cihleh amah in kei aa dingin a hoih thu khatpeuh kamsang ngei lo a, a sia lam vive ahi hi—amah pen Imlah’ tapa Micahyah ahi hi!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahshaphat in, “Kumpipa tua bang na cih ding kilawm lo hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in ulian khat samin, “Tu mahmahin Imlah’ tapa Micahyah hong paipih in!” a ci hi.
Israyl kumpipa leh Yahdah kumpipa in a puantualte uh silhin, Samaria kulh kongpi lutna kiang ancilna phuala a kumpi-tokhomte tungah tu a, amaute mai-ah kamsang khempeuh in kam a sang uh hi.
Chenaanah’ tapa Zedekyah in ama aa dingin sik kite bawlin amah in, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Hih kite tawh amaute a siat matengin Aram mite na nawt ding hi, ci hi,” a ci hi.
A omlai kamsang khempeuh in zong tua mah bangin kamsang uh a, “Gilead ah paito inla, gualzo in! Yahweh in kumpipa khut sungah hong pia ding hi!” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Micahyah sam dingin a kisawl kamtaipa in ama kiangah, “Limtakin ngai in! Kamsangte’ thu kikhatin kumpipa aa dingin a gualzawh ding thu gen uh hi. Tu-in amau gen bangin gen hoh inla, gualzawh ding thu gen in!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Micahyah in, “Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin, Yahweh in kei hong gen thu bek ka gen ding hi,” a ci hi.

Kumpipa kiangah a tun ciangin, kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Micahyah aw, Ramoth Gilead sim ding i hi hiam, ahih keileh omlai phot ding i hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Kuan inla gualzo in! Yahweh in kumpipa’ khut sungah hong pia ding hi!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Thudang gen loin Yahweh’ Min tawh a man thu nong gen nadingin bangzah vei hong ki ciamsak ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah in, “A cing omlo tuu bangin mualte tungah Israyl khempeuh a kithehthang ka mu a, Yahweh in, ‘Hihte in makai nei lo hi. Hih mite khempeuh amau inn ciat ah lungnuamin ciah uh hen,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in Yahshaphat kiangah, “Amah in kei aa dingin a hoih thu kamsang ngei loin a sia bek kamsang hi, hong ci mah hilo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Micahyah in zomlai-in, “Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ kammal ngai in! Yahweh a kumpi-tokhom tungah tu-in, ama kiimkot a vei leh a tak ah vantung mihonpite a ding, ka mu hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in, ‘Ramoth Gilead ah Ahab a si dingin a kuantoh nadingin bang in amah zol ding ahi hiam?’ a ci hi. Khat in hih bangin genin, adang khat in hua bangin a gen hi.
Tua ciangin kha khat hong madawkin, Yahweh mai-ah ding a, ‘Keimah in ka zol ding hi!’ a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah, ‘Bangci bangin hih ding na hi hiam?’ ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, ‘Keimah kuankhia-in, a kamsangte khempeuh kam sungah kha zuau khatin ka va om ding hi,’ a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in, ‘Amah na zol ding a, na zolzo ding hi. Pai inla sem in!’ a ci hi.
En in! Yahweh in hih nangma kamsangte khempeuh kam sungah kha zuau khat a koih khin hi! Yahweh in nangma tungah thusia genzo hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiangah Chenaanah’ tapa Zedekyah hong paito-in, Micahyah a paang bengin, “Yahweh kiang panin bang dan Kha nam in nang tungtawnin thu gen ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Micahyah in ama kiangah, “Man taktak hi, na inndei sungnungpen ah a kibu dingin na pai ni ciangin na thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in, “Micahyah man unla, khuapi ukpa Amon kiang leh kumpipa’ tapa Yahash kiangah puakkik un!
Amaute kiangah: Kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Lungnuamin kei kong ciahkik matengin hih pa thong sungah koih unla, an tawm leh tui tawmtawm bek pia un,” a ci hi.
Micahyah in, “Lungnuamin nong ciahkik leh, Yahweh in kei tungtawnin thu a gen ngei lo hi ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “No mipi khempeuh in ka thugen ciamteh un!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ramoth Gilead ah Israyl kumpipa leh Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat a kuanto uh hi.

Israyl kumpipa in Yahshaphat kiangah, “Keimah in ka meel selin gal sungah ka pai ding a, ahih zongin nangmah in na puantualpi silh in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israyl kumpipa in a meel selin gal sungah a pai hi.
Tu-in Aram kumpipa in a sakolleeng ukte sawmthum le nih kiangah thupia-in, “Israyl kumpipa lo buang a neu ahi a, a lian ahi zongin kuamah do kei un—amah bek do un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin sakolleeng ukte in Yahshaphat a muh uh ciangin amaute in, “Hihpa pen Israyl kumpipa hi taktak ding hi,” ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah a do dingin ama lamah a kihei uh hi; ahih hangin Yahshaphat a kikokhia hi.
Sakolleeng ukte in amah pen Israyl kumpipa a hih loh lam a thei uh ciangin, a nungdelhna uh panin a kiheikhia uh hi.

Ahih hangin mi khatpeuh in a thal mawklot a, thaltang in a kidalnate kikal panin Israyl kumpipa a kha hi. Amah in a sakolleeng hawlpa thupia-in, “Kihei in! Kei liam ka hih manin kidona sung panin hong paikhiatpih in!” a ci hi.
Sun tawntung nasia takin gal kido a, Aram mite maingatin a sakolleeng tungah kumpipa a kingam hi. A liamna panin a sakolleeng sual tungah a sibua-in, tua nitakin amah si hi.
Tua ciangin ni a tum laitakin galkap khempeuh kap henhan uh a, “Mi khempeuh ama khuapi ah! Mi khempeuh ama gam ah!” a ci uh hi.
Tua bangin kumpipa si a, Samaria ah a kipua hi. Amaute in Samaria ah kumpipa a vui uh hi.
Amaute in Samaria-a bual ah a sakolleeng sil uh hi—Yahweh’ kammal a kigensa bang lianin a kizuakte a kisil laitakin uite in a sisan a liak uh hi.
Tu-in Ahab’ uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite leh a sepsa khempeuh, ama lamsa saiha inn leh ama lamsa khuapite khempeuh, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua bangin Ahab a pate tawh ihmu a, Tua ciangin Ahazyah in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Israyl kumpipa Ahab uk zawh a kum lina kumin Asa’ tapa Yahshaphat Yahdah kumpi suak hi.
Yahshaphat in gam uk ding a kipatin amah kum 35 pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmnih le kum nga uk hi. A nu’ min pen Azubah hi a, Shilhi tanu ahi hi.

Amah in a pa Asa’ lampite khempeuh zui hi. Tuate panin amah pial lo a, Yahweh mit ah a manin gamta hi. Ahi zongin mun sangte kihemkhia lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh mite in mun sangte tungah biakpiaknate pia-in gimnamtui hal uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa tawh Yahshaphat kilem hi.
Tu-in Yahshaphat’ uk sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama lahkhiat vangliatna leh bangci banga a galdona-te, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Amah in gam sung panin Asa hun sunga a omlai sun pasal kizuakte a hawlkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Edom ah kumpi omlo hi. Tua hun lai-in kumpipa’ nuai-a khat in a uk hi.
Yahshaphat in Ophir ah kham zongin a pai nadingin Tarshish ah tembawte a lam hi; ahih hangin tuate a paikhia ngei kei hi—Ezion Geber ah tuate kisia hi.
Tua hun ciangin Ahab’ tapa Ahazyah in Yahshaphat kiangah, “Tembawte sungah na mite tawh ka mite hawl khawmsak ni,” ci a, ahih hangin Yahshaphat in a phal kei hi.
Yahshaphat a pate tawh ihmu a, a pa David Khuapi sungah a pate tawh a kivui hi. Tua ciangin Yahram in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yahdah kumpi Yahshaphat’ uk zawh a kum sawm le sagihna kumin Ahab’ tapa Ahazyah Israyl kumpi suak a, Israyl-te kum nih sung a uk hi.
Yahweh mit ah amah a sia-in gamta a, a pa lampi, a nu lampi leh Israyl-te mawhna ah a tun Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam’ lampi a zui hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Ahazyah in Baal’ na semin a bia hi. Amah in a pa hihsa bang teekteekin Israyl’ Pa Yahweh a hehsak nading a piangsak hi.
